paragraphs: He is mentioned in the Jerusalem Talmud, Sheviit, chapter 2, halakhah 5.

notes.text: The supplied heading names Chuna bar Chama. The saved Guggenheimer digital text of Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 2:5 instead has Chuna bar Chiyya (חונא בר חייא / חונה בר חייא). The heading and locator are retained; their relationship to that witness remains unresolved.

The Vilna-based text of Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 2:5 gives Chuna bar Chama in Rabbi Yose’s statement, followed by Chuna bar Chiyya in Rabbi Yonah’s report in Shmuel’s name. The named Wikisource halakhah gives the same contrast. Guggenheimer’s edition reads Chuna bar Chiyya at both points. The edition comparison leaves the figures’ relationship open.
